# Outdoor Gear Lab

> > Independent expert testing and ranking of outdoor equipment across all sports and activities, from climbing to paddling to fitness.

Outdoor Gear Lab is a comprehensive resource for tested and ranked outdoor gear reviews. The site features professional evaluations of equipment from major brands like Patagonia, The North Face, Arc'teryx, and Black Diamond across multiple outdoor disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Product Reviews
- Gear Testing
- Product Rankings
- Outdoor Equipment
- Tested & Ranked
- Gear Comparison
- Independent Reviews
- Hiking Boots
- Tents
- Backpacking
- Mountain Bikes
- Climbing Gear
- Jackets
- Gear Guides
- Brand Reviews

## Core Gear Categories

- [Hiking & Camping](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/camping-and-hiking): Top backpacking, hiking and camping gear tested by outdoor experts
- [Men's Clothing](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/clothing-mens): Tested & ranked men's outdoor clothing from brands like Patagonia
- [Women's Clothing](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/clothing-womens): Tested & ranked women's outdoor apparel and jackets by experts
- [Shoes & Boots](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/shoes-and-boots): Hiking footwear & trail running shoes tested and ranked by GearLab
- [Climbing Gear](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/climbing): Climbing gear reviews: shoes, harnesses, helmets from Petzl, Black Diamond
- [Biking Gear](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/biking): Mountain bikes, e-bikes and accessories tested and ranked
- [Snow Sports Gear](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/snow-sports): Ski equipment, winter clothing and snow sports gear comparison
- [Paddling Gear](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/paddling): Kayaks, SUPs and paddling gear tested by water sports experts

## Backpacking & Camping Guides

- [Backpacking](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/t/backpacking): Backpacking gear guide: packs, boots, sleeping pads and essentials
- [The Ultimate Backpacking Checklist for 2026](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/topics/camping-and-hiking/best-backpacking-gear-list): Ultimate backpacking checklist and packing list for outdoor trips
- [The Best Backpacking Tents of 2026](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/topics/camping-and-hiking/best-backpacking-tent): Best backpacking tents 2026: Big Agnes, Nemo, lightweight options
- [Tents](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/t/tents): Tent buying guide: backpacking, ultralight, and 4-season tents tested
- [Camping Gear](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/t/camping): Camping gear reviews: tents, sleeping bags, stoves and coolers
- [The Best Fire Pits of 2026](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/topics/camping-and-hiking/best-fire-pit): Best fire pits tested: smoke-free and propane options compared

## Activity-Specific Guides

- [Hiking Gear](https://www.outdoorgearlab.com/t/hiking): Hiking gear guide: boots, shoes, daypacks and trekking poles tested
